about: Sermon details found as explicit written evidence (poster text, video titles), applied by scripts/import-sermons.php to the sermon that has the source. Only fills empty fields. Never inferred from faces or voices. Speaker = the speaker's display name with their current title; speaker_slug is the name without a title, so links stay stable when a title changes (church, 2026-09-16: Apostle Eljay Payopay, Prophet Czarina Payopay; assigned pastors Pastor Carol Reyes, Pastor Justine Arceo).
